excludedArtifacts.reason: Initial SUMO reference had uncontrolled-junction priority braking, which this geometry stage does not implement. Replaced by protected movements.
Earlier departure at 12 s did not exercise rounding onto the phase boundary with the trimmed approach. Replaced by departure 13 s: SUMO enters at 29.6 s and HTC at tick 30.
The 240-second runner deadline expired during progressing two-JVM execution under parallel build/test load. Incomplete output is excluded; fresh accepted-bus-de used 600 seconds and completed.

limitations: Runtime link crossings still round to whole ticks; no fractional residual time carryover.
No uncontrolled conflict priority, gap acceptance or competing cross-traffic acceptance.
No multi-lane junction lane choice or shared downstream conflict-area blocking.
Road routing does not price turn costs; the cyclic Bus fixture forces its unique corridor.
Geometry is opt-in; no general city-network importer. SUMO fixture importer requires uniform speed over a movement chain.
Each movement adds a fixed Link LP, lane/shape state and rollback history. No city-scale throughput or heap claim.
Migration stays disabled. These tests do not validate independent restart or recovery.
